races.display_title: DragonBet Welsh Racing Festival 9th-11th Oct Nursery
races.verdict: CRYSTAL KRAKEN matched her previous best despite a very slow start when second in a similar contest over C&D 3 weeks ago and she looks up to going one place better on that evidence reunited with Rossa Ryan. Market confidence behind nursery debutantes Lion of Persia and/or Naval Cop would put a different slant on things, however. CRYSTAL KRAKEN LION OF PERSIA (IRE) NAVAL COP
races.betting_forecast: Crystal Kraken (13/8), Lion Of Persia (11/4), Naval Cop (5/1), Our Fella (15/2), Courseyoudo (8/1), Devon Angel (10/1)

races.display_title: Eddie & Sandra Hayward Supports Noahs Ark Charity Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WASHINGTON ROYALE has shaped with promise on all 3 starts in stronger company to date, latterly when fifth in a big-field Goodwood maiden 5 weeks ago. Remaining with potential for better still, he shades preference over Irish raider Ischgl who has shown enough himself to think a race of this nature is within his grasp. Beechwood Glory may emerge best of the remainder. WASHINGTON ROYALE ISCHGL (IRE) BEECHWOOD GLORY (IRE)

races.display_title: Paving Fields Construction Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PEROLA still needs to confirm himself as effective on turf but the pick of his all-weather exploits suggest he's up to landing a race of this nature and with the return to sprinting a positive back from another break, he could be the answer. Persian Gate rates a likely improver with his debut run under his belt and can provide the chief threat. PEROLA (FR) PERSIAN GATE (IRE) KODICALL (IRE)

races.display_title: Squadron Flyer At Aldwark Manor Estate EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ARENITE looks capable of better again and can make it third time lucky. Ouragan 's second at Newbury is a standout in her 4 starts but it was the only occasion she's tackled turf and she could pose a threat if recapturing that form. Harry Who showed promise as he got the hang of things towards the end of his Thirsk debut and is next on the list. ARENITE OURAGAN (IRE) HARRY WHO (IRE)

races.display_title: Betfred 'Nifty 50' Amateurs' Derby Handicap (Gentleman Amateur Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: EDWARD SEXTON is very lightly raced on the Flat but mixed it with some smart sorts in bumpers and still looks ahead of his mark having been raised 5 lb for his Haydock win. Crooked Path made a successful start for the Owen yard last time and has to be feared given his handler's record with new recruits, while Divine Knight has been expensive to follow since joining William Haggas but has the eye-catching booking of Henry Callan. EDWARD SEXTON (IRE) CROOKED PATH (IRE) DIVINE KNIGHT (IRE)

races.display_title: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict: Cases can be made for several, but the vote goes to JUST TYPICAL , who has dipped below his last winning mark and with a strong gallop likely, Ian Williams' 5-y-o can open his account for the campaign reunited with Billy Loughnane. races.verdict: TELL NOBODY NOTHIN was placed off 5 lb higher over hurdles last spring so might be worth chancing now back over the smaller obstacles. Down Around had the run of the race when winning at Ballinrobe last time but could easily have more to come for new trainer Gordon Elliott and is second choice ahead of the other Noel Meade runner Mickey Cohen . TELL NOBODY NOTHIN (IRE) DOWN AROUND (IRE) MICKEY COHEN (IRE)

races.verdict: Plenty in with a squeak but the vote goes to MERISI DIAMOND , who scrambled home at the Curragh back in April and Thomas Coyle's 7-y-o remains on a handy mark after just a 2 lb nudge. Provided he's ready to roll, he can enhance his good record here at the expense of another track-specialist Earls , with Ninth Crusade and Highbury See See a couple worthy of consideration, too. MERISI DIAMOND (IRE) EARLS (IRE) NINTH CRUSADE (IRE)
